citation_details.title: Prisoner's Dilemma EEG Dataset
citation_details.author: n/a
citation_details.abstract: A three-person hyperscanning EEG dataset from a prisoner's dilemma experiment comprising 11 triads (33 participants total). EEG signals were simultaneously recorded from all three participants during decision-making, feedback, and rest phases. The dataset includes behavioral labels and is formatted according to BIDS standards with data stored in EEGLAB format. This dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds007822 (v1.0.0). Original authors are listed as 'n/a' in the source dataset metadata; for questions regarding original data collection, please contact the OpenNeuro repository or the NEMAR data curation team.
